features.name: Smart invoices
features.summary: Create a branded invoice in under a minute and send it straight from Ledgerly.
features.detail: Pick a client, add an amount and a due date, and Ledgerly fills in the rest: your logo, payment link and tax line.

features.name: Automatic reminders
features.summary: Late payers get a polite nudge on the schedule you choose.
features.detail: Reminders go out 3 days before, on, and 7 days after the due date. Every reminder is logged on the invoice.

features.name: Cash-flow reports
features.summary: See what is paid, what is overdue, and what to expect this month.
features.detail: The reports page groups every invoice by status and exports the whole list as CSV for your accountant.
